h1: Custom CNB Vests for Bulk Orders
metaDescription: Order custom CNB vests in bulk for your team. Perfect for branding with logos. Fast turnaround from Perfect Imprints.
introHtml: CNB vests combine durable construction with professional styling, making them a go-to choice for corporate uniforms, safety teams, and promotional events. Unlike generic vests, CNB offers a range of cuts from quilted puffers to reversible designs, all built to hold up to daily wear. Add your logo through embroidery or screen printing for a polished look that keeps your brand visible on the job site or at outdoor events.
heroAltText: Custom CNB vests with embroidered logos in various colors and styles for corporate branding
